title: WebQAmGaze: A Multilingual Webcam Eye-Tracking-While-Reading Dataset
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. A single example text provided in a figure mentioned 'religious views' but this was not a systematic part of the study.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The only mention of religion was in a single example text about Nikola Tesla's 'religious views', which was used to illustrate the dataset's structure but was not part of any analysis related to religion.
